title: Removed permission still declared in Data Safety
subject: android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO
summary: android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO was removed between pulsefit-1.2.0.apk and pulsefit-1.3.0.apk, but the Data Safety form still declares "audio.voice_or_sound_recordings". The store surface has drifted from the product.
comparison: removedPermissions contains android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO; declared(collectedDataTypes still contains "audio.voice_or_sound_recordings")
remediation: Re-answer the affected Data Safety questions for this release so the form stops over-claiming.

title: New network destination not disclosed
subject: metrics.amplitude.com
summary: New network destination metrics.amplitude.com appears in the candidate build and is disclosed in neither the Data Safety destinations nor the privacy policy.
remediation: Confirm what data flows to this destination and disclose it, or remove the integration that introduced it.

title: Declared data type has no supporting build evidence
subject: calendar.calendar_events
summary: Data Safety declares collection of "calendar.calendar_events", but neither the base nor the candidate build contains android.permission.READ_CALENDAR or android.permission.WRITE_CALENDAR. The claim currently rests on nothing observable.
comparison: declared("calendar.calendar_events") vs observed(no android.permission.READ_CALENDAR|android.permission.WRITE_CALENDAR in either build)
remediation: Confirm the collection path and attach evidence, or narrow the Data Safety declaration.

title: New third-party SDK without any disclosure
subject: com.amplitude
summary: New SDK Amplitude Analytics (Amplitude) is present in the build but disclosed nowhere the team has declared.
comparison: observed(com.amplitude via com/amplitude) vs declared(no Data Safety disclosure, no privacy-policy mention)
remediation: Disclose the SDK and its data practices in the Data Safety form and privacy policy, or remove it from the build.

title: New dangerous permission not covered by Data Safety answers
subject: android.permission.CAMERA
summary: Build declares android.permission.CAMERA (Camera (photos)), but the Data Safety form does not list "photos_and_videos.photos". One of them is wrong.
